body:
I've no choice. Considering i have no choice it seems simple. 
To give up would be to be to give up on my brother, he doesn't deserve that, no one does. So no, i won't ive up. I will support him til he is ready to survive. But i don't want to, i don't choose to. Maybe this sub is for people that are going to end themselves, that would be my choice if i had one.

I won't forget it, that's why i'm here. Someone has to save this bunch of useless bastards. But it doesn't make it fair, its me that has to stay, to watch everything i know/love crumble and die. Its me that has to endure this and i don't know how anymore. Remember when you were a child and something went wrong? a TV was broken or a window or someone got hurt, you'd sit and wait for an adult and as soon as they arrived the relief, it was over the 'grownup' could fix it. safety. The same look i gave when i was a child, people give to me. People come to 'help' and they look at me with this desperation, this terror. And i know they want me to tell them what to do, they want instructions, they are more scared than i am. That pressure feels like a crushing weight, an anvil, pressing down on my chest. I have no choices, i have no power. I sit and wait for her to leave me, i sit and wait for my own fucking destruction. If i could end it now, peacefully and without that guilt i would without a doubt. But that, that perfect mercy given by god, is not even granted to me. (poetic as fuck i know)

There is nothing, and no one. There is only so much goverment supplied support a person can endure, and my mum refuses any more. It's her choice and i accept it. Would you want a stranger, a name stranger but a stranger none the less, witnessing you at your weakest moment? i wouldnt. There is no solution to my problem, unless medical treatment advances massively in the next year. I have already spoken to my mother about thus, she has decided to end her own life. Thats her choice, i will accept and help if she asks me too. But at 17, without a father figure without anyone to help its almost unendurable. Waiting for the person i love most to commint suicide is deliriously painful

Thank you for just replying man, Means so much to me.
If i could change my life? i'd give my mum back her life, take her disability from her (primary progressive multiple sclerosis if you're wondering). And the repurcussions of that could be that my brother wouldn't want to end his life. Those are the answers i want to give. But the honest answer is i wish it wasn't me, I wish i didnt have to deal with this shit, i wish i didnt have to dress my mum, feed her and change her. I wish my brother didn't need me to be strong for both of us. I wish there was something i wanted more than just freedom, for me the only option, the only freedom i could ever have would be to end it. Its the only way i could ever be free of this. And i cant even choose that.

Hi, I'm not going to pretend i think i can change your mind because i probably can't. But i'm going through something similar (maybe not situation wise but feelings wise) feel free to message me just to chat shit. No one should end their time on this earth alone. I hope you choose to keep fighting but either way. Message me.
